# KawaHive & Partners

> KawaHive & Partners provides go-to-market (GTM) strategy and structured execution support for founders with a registered MedTech or medical device product or service across Asia-Pacific (APAC). KawaHive helps founders assess market demand, prioritise target accounts, understand hospital buying decisions, strengthen distributor execution and turn market interest into customer orders.

## Who KawaHive supports

KawaHive works with founders whose MedTech or medical device product or service is registered and who need to strengthen customer demand, market focus, distributor performance or conversion from hospital interest to orders.

KawaHive & Partners is a new advisory practice built on more than 20 years of MedTech and medical device industry experience across Asia-Pacific. The practice draws on prior professional roles with organisations including GE Healthcare, Fujifilm, Pentax and Konica Minolta. These are previous industry backgrounds, not KawaHive client engagements.

## What KawaHive helps founders do

- Prioritise APAC markets, clinical segments and customer groups.
- Define an ideal customer profile (ICP) and select target hospital or account types.
- Understand clinical-user needs, department priorities and hospital buying behaviour.
- Map stakeholders, including clinical users, department heads, biomedical engineering, procurement and budget holders.
- Clarify product positioning and value proposition for relevant customer groups.
- Assess distributor capability, account coverage, performance and sell-through.
- Identify why demonstrations, evaluations and trials are not progressing to purchase orders.
- Build a focused go-to-market action plan with owners, next steps and evidence.
- Review progress and make evidence-informed decisions to continue, change or stop an approach.

## Market segments

KawaHive's current focus areas across MedTech and medical devices are:
- Radiology and medical imaging
- Surgery
- Obstetrics and gynaecology (OBGYN)
- Urology
- Rehabilitation
- Gastroenterology and endoscopy

## Offers

### Free 30-Minute GTM Clarity Call

A no-obligation 30-minute online call to understand the founder's situation and assess whether KawaHive is a suitable fit. If the fit is appropriate, KawaHive reviews the information the founder chooses to share and prepares a high-level GTM action plan in approximately one week, depending on the information provided. The founder keeps the plan and may implement it independently. If KawaHive is not the right fit, KawaHive will recommend someone better suited at no cost.

### 10-Week Go-to-Market Sprint

Price: US$3,500.

A structured, dedicated 1:1 engagement for founders with a registered MedTech or medical device product or service. It includes one 60-minute online session each week for 10 weeks and focuses on one primary go-to-market challenge. Work covers diagnosis, prioritisation, action planning, execution review and evidence-informed adjustments. Sales, funding, regulatory approval and market-entry outcomes are not guaranteed.

## Important boundaries

KawaHive provides go-to-market strategy and business support. It is not a regulatory consultancy and does not provide clinical, medical, technical certification, legal or investment advice. Content is general information. KawaHive does not guarantee sales, funding, regulatory approval, introductions or market-entry outcomes.

## Geographic scope and content coverage

KawaHive focuses on go-to-market strategy for registered MedTech and medical device products or services across Asia-Pacific. The website covers radiology and medical imaging, surgery, OBGYN, urology, rehabilitation, and gastroenterology/endoscopy. Country-specific purchasing, procurement, distributor and market-entry conditions should be validated for each target market; APAC is not a single uniform market.
